newsitem.title: USA: Glimcher Realty partnership acquires mall.
newsitem.headline: Glimcher Realty partnership acquires mall.

text.p: Glimcher Properties Ltd Partnership said on Thursday that it had acquired the Dayton Mall for $91 million in a joint venture with Nomura Capital.
The property, a 1.3-million-square-foot facility, was bought from one of the institutional clients fo Heitman Capital Management, Glimcher said in a statement.
The transaction was funded using mortgage financing of $61.5 million and equity contributions from Glimcher and Nomura Capital, Glimcher said.
Glimcher Properties is the operating partnership of Glimcher Realty Trust, a real estate investment trust that owns and manages 114 properties in 24 states.
The mall recently underwent a $25 million renovation, featuring the construction of a new JCPenney department store, Glimcher added.
